issues.t: High-pressure fuel pipe can loosen and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell in or around the van, or wet fuel on top of the engine.
issues.why: The nuts on the high-pressure crossover fuel pipe between the engine's two cylinder banks can work loose, partly because too little thread lubricant was used at the factory. Kia had 258 leak reports before recalling more than 141,000 vans (Kia SC368, NHTSA 26V-232).
issues.next: If you smell fuel, park outside away from buildings and have it checked before driving. Book the free recall inspection; if you already paid for this repair, ask Kia for reimbursement.

issues.t: Power sliding door may not reverse when it hits something (recall)
issues.sym: The power sliding door keeps closing even when a hand, arm or object is in the way.
issues.why: The door's auto-reverse safety function did not trigger in every situation. NHTSA opened an investigation (PE22-004) after injury reports, and Kia recalled all 2022 and some 2023 vans to update the door control software (Kia SC266, NHTSA 23V-236).
issues.next: Have the free software update done. Until then, watch children around the sliding doors and close them by hand when in doubt.

issues.t: Passenger sliding door may not latch (recall)
issues.sym: A door-ajar warning, or the right sliding door does not latch fully when closed.
issues.why: The remote control unit for the passenger power sliding door can malfunction, so the door may not latch and could open while driving. Kia SC221, NHTSA 21V-908.
issues.next: Do not drive with a door-ajar warning. Have the dealer replace the door release actuator drum and holder for free.

issues.t: Roof trim molding can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Wind noise or flapping from the roof, or a strip of roof trim lifting or missing.
issues.why: The roof molding can loosen and fly off, which is a hazard for cars behind. Some owners say glued repairs did not hold. Kia SC292, NHTSA 24V-025.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and secure or replace the molding for free. If it comes back loose, go back; it is covered by the recall.

issues.t: Tow hitch wiring module can short and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. Smoke or a burning smell near the rear of the van, even when parked.
issues.why: Water can get into the circuit board of the trailer hitch wiring harness and cause a short circuit, which can start a fire. NHTSA 23V-179 covers vans with a factory or dealer-installed tow hitch harness.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. If your van has a tow hitch harness, park outside away from buildings until the free fix (a new fuse and wiring kit) is done.

issues.t: Plastic fuel rail tube can be damaged and leak (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell or a fuel leak in the engine bay.
issues.why: A plastic fuel tube on the fuel rail could have been damaged, letting fuel leak and raising the risk of fire. NHTSA 21V-277 covers certain early 2022 vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the dealer inspect and replace the fuel rail if needed.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge cluster turns off or shows nothing, so you lose the speedometer, tire pressure and warning lights.
issues.why: A software error can make the instrument panel display fail. Kia SC361, NHTSA 26V-046.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Accept the free over-the-air update or have a dealer install it.

issues.t: Top speed suddenly limited to about 30 mph
issues.sym: With the pedal to the floor the van will not go faster than about 30 mph, sometimes on a highway ramp. A check engine light may or may not appear. Turning the van off and on often clears it for a while.
issues.why: Many owners from 2022 through 2026 report this. No cause has been confirmed; dealers have tried transmission resets and pointed at cruise control, and cold weather seems to make it more likely.
issues.next: If it happens, put your hazards on and get to a safe spot. Restarting may clear it. Report it to the dealer with dates and any codes, and file an NHTSA complaint.

issues.t: Sliding door closes on hands with too much force
issues.sym: The power sliding door pinches hands, arms or fingers before it reverses, or does not stop for a stroller or object.
issues.why: Owners say the door's pinch sensor needs too much force to trigger. Complaints continue after the 2022–2023 software recall, including on 2025 vans.
issues.next: Teach children to stay clear while the door moves and use the button to stop it. Report injuries to NHTSA and ask the dealer to check the door's settings and software.

issues.t: Sliding doors won't latch or show door-ajar
issues.sym: A sliding door will not latch, will not lock, opens by itself, or a door-ajar warning stays on.
issues.why: Owners report latch and door-control faults on the power sliding doors. Lubrication alone has not fixed some cases; others needed latch parts replaced.
issues.next: Do not drive with a door that is not latched. Have the latch and door module checked under warranty and ask about open recalls.

issues.t: Windshield cracks easily and spreads
issues.sym: A crack appears from a small stone or for no clear reason and keeps spreading.
issues.why: Many 2022 and 2023 owners report windshields cracking easily. Replacement glass has sometimes been on backorder for weeks.
issues.next: Check your insurance glass coverage. Make sure the shop recalibrates the forward camera after a replacement.

issues.t: Hybrid loses power when switching between gas and electric
issues.sym: The van suddenly loses power or stalls, often as it switches between electric and gas running, then needs time to restart. Speed may also be capped near 30 mph.
issues.why: Owners of the new Carnival Hybrid report sudden loss of drive power. No cause or fix has been confirmed yet; dealers have not always been able to reproduce it.
issues.next: Get to safety with your hazards on. Have the dealer scan for codes and check for hybrid software updates, and file an NHTSA complaint.

issues.t: Battery drains flat while parked
issues.sym: The van will not start after sitting one to a few days, the key fob may stop working, or Kia Connect sends a battery discharge warning.
issues.why: Kia found that the central communication unit (CCU) kept drawing power from the 12-volt battery after shutdown on vans built April to August 2024, and issued a service bulletin and over-the-air software update. Owners of 2026 vans report similar drain.
issues.next: Make sure the latest software update is installed. If the battery still dies, have the dealer test it and do a parasitic drain test.

issues.t: Limp mode in extreme cold from an iced throttle body
issues.sym: In very cold weather the check engine light comes on (often code P2118) and the van will not go above about 10–15 mph or may stall.
issues.why: Moisture in the throttle body can freeze. Owners were told this design no longer heats the throttle body.
issues.next: Have the dealer clear the ice and check the throttle body. In severe cold, park in a garage if possible.

issues.t: Shudder or shaking when accelerating
issues.sym: Shaking or shuddering on acceleration, often on cold starts or above 40 mph, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: Some cases were traced to an engine misfire, with dealers replacing a fuel injector or citing an injector sensor fault. Others were never diagnosed.
issues.next: Have the codes read while the light is on. Keep records of each visit if the problem repeats.

issues.t: Engine stalls while driving
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving or at low mileage, sometimes on the highway.
issues.why: NHTSA complaints describe stalls that dealers often could not explain. One van was later found to have a cylinder problem with coolant burning inside the engine.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Get to a safe place and have it towed. Ask for a full diagnosis, including a coolant loss check, and keep all paperwork.

issues.t: Fuel gauge reads empty with fuel left
issues.sym: The gauge or range shows empty while there is still plenty of fuel in the tank.
issues.why: Owners report a faulty fuel level reading; a failed fuel level sender is the usual cause of this kind of fault.
issues.next: Track your mileage between fill-ups so you do not run dry, and have the gauge checked under warranty.

issues.t: Air conditioning stops working
issues.sym: The A/C blows warm air, sometimes more than once.
issues.why: Repeated A/C failures are among the top electrical complaints for the 2024 Carnival.
issues.next: Have a shop check for leaks and electrical faults before just recharging it.

issues.t: Second-row seatback can fold forward suddenly
issues.sym: When lifted or adjusted, a second-row seatback snaps forward with a lot of force.
issues.why: Owners report the seat mechanism releasing unexpectedly.
issues.next: Keep hands and children clear when adjusting the seat and have the dealer inspect the latch.

issues.t: Screens, cameras and driver-assist systems glitch
issues.sym: Screens and cameras shut off or reboot, the speedometer drops to zero, warning lights appear, or the van brakes for no reason.
issues.why: Owners describe electronic faults on 2026 vans. No cause has been published.
issues.next: Note the time and take photos of warnings. Ask the dealer for software updates and file an NHTSA complaint for any braking event.

issues.t: Early oil leak from the oil pan gasket
issues.sym: Oil spots under the van or oil on the bottom of the engine at low mileage.
issues.why: Owners report oil pan gasket leaks on new vans.
issues.next: Check the oil level and have the leak fixed under warranty.
